title_en: Event Announcement: Ulsan Industrial AX Action Conference
summary: The department has posted an announcement of the Ulsan Industrial AX Action Conference. The notice text contains only the title and two attachments: an event overview with a detailed schedule, and a poster. The attachments were not read, so the dates, location, eligibility and any registration requirements are not available here.
conditions: The notice text does not state who may attend, whether attendance is required, or any registration conditions; these may appear in the attachments, which were not read.
steps: Open the two attachments to the original notice for the event details: Attachment 1, the event overview and detailed schedule (울산 산업 AX 액션 컨퍼런스 행사 개요 및 세부일정.hwp), and Attachment 2, the poster (포스터.png). Their content was not read for this translation.
For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
